messages.en:

about your clothes anyway?"

üldse huvitab, mida teised

{06 01 00 0c 0d 0e}

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Real beauty doesn't come
from clothes. {01 00 00 05 00}That's just a
superficial way to think.
No, no. {07 0c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Beauty is skin-deep.{01 00 00 05 00}
Literally. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0a 00}A nice complexion
is the key to beauty.
{06 00 00 12 13}
messages.et:

riietest. {01 00 00 05 00}See on lihtsalt
pealiskaudne mõtteviis.
Ei, ei. {07 0c 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Ilu on nahapealne.{01 00 00 05 00}
Sõna-sõnalt. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0a 00}Ilus jume
on ilu võti.
{06 00 00 12 13}

messages.en:

{ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}, is{01 00 00 0a 00} just out of this
world, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.

{ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} on{01 00 00 0a 00} lihtsalt

messages.en:
{07 17 00}You might not think it {01 00 00 05 00}but
I'm really into comedy. {01 00 00 0a 00}I
just love to laugh.{01 01 00}{07 03 00} See?
{07 0d 00}Anyhoo,{01 00 00 0a 00} what should I wear
to the next comedy show?

meeldib komöödia. {01 00 00 0a 00}Ma
armastan naerda.{01 01 00}{07 03 00} Näed?
{07 0d 00}Igatahes,{01 00 00 0a 00} mida kanda

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Everybody seems to be
reading this magazine called
{ff 00 00 02}Ms. Nintendique{ff 00 00 00}.
I read this article on how
to determine what your
power animal is.
It's so obvious, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}it's really
starting to confuse me.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Kõik näivad lugevat
ajakirja nimega
{ff 00 00 02}Ms. Nintendique{ff 00 00 00}.
Lugesin artiklit sellest,
kuidas määrata oma
väeloom.
See on nii ilmselge, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}et see
ajab mind segadusse.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You've thought about
rocking some more feminine
looks, haven't you?{02 00 00 0a 0b}
Maybe...
Uh, no...
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa oled mõelnud
naiselikuma stiili
peale, kas pole?{02 00 00 0a 0b}
Võib-olla...
Ee, ei...

messages.en:
{07 13 00}I'd really like to own a tux.
{01 00 00 0a 00}I'd look SOOO cute,{01 00 00 0a 00} just
like a penguin!
{07 0d 00}And everyone would be all
like,{01 00 00 0a 00} "Who's that cute girl
in the tux?!"
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Tahaksin väga frakki.
{01 00 00 0a 00}Näeksin NII armas välja,{01 00 00 0a 00}
just nagu pingviin!
{07 0d 00}Ja kõik ütleksid:{01 00 00 0a 00} „Kes on
see armas tüdruk
frakis?!”

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Yeah, a lot of guys here
are into that. {01 00 00 05 00}Just look at
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00}.
Have you seen that apron
of his?! {01 01 00}{07 11 00}I could swear it's
really just a skirt!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Jah, paljudele siinsetele
poistele see meeldib. {01 00 00 05 00}Vaata
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nooki{ff 00 00 00}.
Kas oled näinud tema
põlle?! {01 01 00}{07 11 00}Võin vanduda, et see
on tegelikult seelik!

messages.en:
{07 0b 00}Oh,{01 00 00 05 00} really?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}Life isn't just
about {01 00 00 0f 00}cowboy hats and
jeans, you know.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}Oi,{01 00 00 05 00} tõesti?{01 00 00 0a 00} {07 14 00}Elu ei käi
ainult {01 00 00 0f 00}kauboikübarate ja
teksade ümber, tead küll.

messages.en:
That's why they call it
"personal style,"{01 00 00 05 00} and not
"everyone else's style."
{07 14 00}If people really cared that
much about pleasing others,{01 00 00 0a 00}
nobody would design clothes!
messages.et:
Sellepärast öeldaksegi
„isiklik stiil”,{01 00 00 05 00} mitte
„kõigi teiste stiil”.
{07 14 00}Kui inimesi tõesti nii väga
huvitaks teiste arvamus,{01 00 00 0a 00}
ei kujundaks keegi riideid!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I agree with you, but{01 00 00 05 00} if you
take the whole not caring
thing too far{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You can end up looking like
a hobo. And most people
aren't friends with hobos.
Except for other hobos.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Nõustun sinuga, aga{01 00 00 05 00} kui
ajada seda mittehoolimist
liiga kaugele{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}võid lõpuks välja näha
nagu hulkur. Ja enamik ei
sõbrusta hulkuritega.
Peale teiste hulkurite.

messages.en:
{07 05 00}{01 08 00}Just wear whatever you
want!{01 00 00 14 00} .{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}I just needed to
get that off my chest.
messages.et:

tahad!{01 00 00 14 00} .{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 00 00}Pidin selle
lihtsalt südamelt saama.

{07 11 00}The secret to style is{01 00 00 05 00}
confidence! {01 00 00 05 00}Just wear what

{07 1b 00}Of course, it doesn't hurt
to be super pretty, {01 00 00 05 00}like
me.

{07 11 00}Stiili saladus on{01 00 00 05 00}
enesekindlus! {01 00 00 05 00}Kanna seda,
mis sulle sobib!
{07 1b 00}Muidugi ei tee paha
olla ülimalt ilus, {01 00 00 05 00}nagu

{07 11 00}In fact, it's usually the

{07 1b 00}If you have no style, you
